assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome
Diagnosis codes are R55 and I49.5
Mobile cardiac telemetry service was performed (CPT 93229)
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings during daily activities
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the specific clinical need described in the indication note
